newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover up 0.6 pct in latest qtr.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover up 0.6 pct in latest qtr.

text.p: Total turnover of Brtiain's engineering industries increased by 0.6 percent in the three months to February compared with the previous three months, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
That was due to an increase of 1.5 per cent in export turnover. Home turnover remained flat. Compared to the same period a year ago total turnover increased by 0.7 percent.
Total orders on hand at the end of February fell by 3.5 percent compared to the end of November 1996, and were 4.2 per cent down on February 1996.
